reason: $24.99 launch, or $29.99 after, is still more than Toplux at $23 or Goli at $19, and I already compare per day. I would wait for a flash sale or coupon instead of paying a first-box price.
objection: I can get magnesium for less and I do not know that named-lab testing and a pre-counted sachet are worth $6 to $10 more a month. I forget vitamins half the time anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A first box at about $19 to $20, or a TikTok Shop flash sale or coupon that takes it near that, with the empty-box guarantee still in place.
